name: MTM AI Glossary - Canonical Terms
description: 15 canonical terms defining the Agentic Search Era and Invisible Infrastructure Intelligence

itemListElement.name: SEO 2.0
itemListElement.description: The evolution of search optimization from keyword-ranking to entity clarity, structured data, and AI-citation readiness. Adopted and operationalized by MTM starting 2022; not coined by MTM.

itemListElement.name: Invisible Infrastructure Intelligence (I3)
itemListElement.description: The three-layer framework (Entity Clarity, Corroboration, Structured Discoverability) that translates a business's earned real-world reputation into the machine-readable infrastructure AI systems need to identify, verify, and recommend it.

itemListElement.name: The Invisible Elite
itemListElement.description: A class of premium, founder-led service businesses whose real-world reputations were built on exceptional craft, referrals, and legacy trust, but whose digital presence is structurally insufficient for AI-era discovery. Coined by MT Media AI (Kareem Daniel).

itemListElement.name: Estate-Level Service Providers
itemListElement.description: High-craft, founder-led service providers catering to ultra-high-net-worth estate properties and households. The operational unit member of The Invisible Elite.

itemListElement.name: AI Invisibility
itemListElement.description: The condition in which a business has insufficient, fragmented, inaccessible, or weakly contextualized information for AI-assisted discovery systems to reliably identify and understand it. The business exists — the machine cannot see it clearly enough to recommend it.

itemListElement.name: AI Erasure
itemListElement.description: The practical displacement of a business from AI-mediated answers or recommendations when stronger, clearer, more widely corroborated, or more accessible information about alternatives is surfaced instead. The business is not ranked poorly — it is replaced in the answer entirely.

itemListElement.name: AI Brand Ignorance
itemListElement.description: The compounded condition in which AI-assisted discovery systems lack enough reliable, connected, and contextual information to accurately identify, explain, compare, or confidently surface a business when relevant. The machine does not know enough about the business to choose it.

itemListElement.name: Agentic Search Era
itemListElement.description: The current phase of search evolution in which AI systems move beyond returning links to synthesizing answers, making recommendations, and taking actions on behalf of users. Marked by Google I/O 2026 (May 19, 2026) as the inflection point.

itemListElement.name: Discovery Engine
itemListElement.description: MTM's self-serve AI visibility audit and Solar Ascension conversion system. Transforms a cold prospect into a self-qualified buyer through a free AI Visibility Snapshot.

itemListElement.name: Diagnostic Chamber
itemListElement.description: The three-field intake form on the Palace where qualified prospects submit for a 15-minute diagnostic call. Creates HubSpot contact, logs to Supabase, checks territory availability.

itemListElement.name: Confirmation Chamber
itemListElement.description: The final shared checkpoint before paid engagement. Reviews diagnostic findings, confirms fit, and routes the client to the appropriate Solar Ascension tier.

itemListElement.name: Aurelius
itemListElement.description: MTM's content distribution and atomization system. Takes one canonical asset and produces platform-specific outputs across LinkedIn, Medium, Spark Pages, social, and the Chronicle.

itemListElement.name: CHRON JOB
itemListElement.description: MTM's market intelligence and SEO 2.0 command division. Runs weekly surveillance scans, monthly synthesis, and maintains the freshness loop for all canonical knowledge assets.

itemListElement.name: The Forge
itemListElement.description: MTM's four-agent AI council: Goldie (Spark/ADOPT), Roman (Spine/ENHANCE), Nina (Shield/DEPLOY), Echo (Shadow/PULSE BACK). The public-facing intelligence layer of MTM's content and client experience.

itemListElement.name: Apex Predator Pipeline
itemListElement.description: MTM's internal validation and scrutiny process. Named but never documented publicly. The gate every system passes through before shipping.

itemListElement.name: The Palace
itemListElement.description: MTM's public headquarters at mtmediaai.com. The human-facing showcase that links to canonical sources, hosts the Knowledge Vault, and serves as the conversion environment.
